title: 第3章 睡一张床第4章 龙渊卫副將
content_zh:
大乾国崇尚武道，武者分为聚气，炼神，通玄，化劫，宗师五大境界。
成为宗师，才等於拥有修仙的敲门砖。
但修仙功法全部大乾皇族所垄断，皇族以此为诱饵，近乎掌控整个大乾皇朝的武道势力。
楚夏深知，在大乾想要获得一部修仙功法，是多么困难。
父亲为大乾戎马半生，杀敌无数，所求也不过是一部修仙功法而已，可至死都未能如愿。
想不到，楚夏竟如此轻易就获得了。
而且还是上品仙诀！
来不及多想，楚夏已经盘膝而坐，开始运转灵力，修炼大日阳神诀。
这一练，就是半天。
直到天色渐渐暗下来，楚夏驀然睁开双眼。
“居然突破炼神境了！”
楚夏很是惊喜意外。
他虽是聚气九重，但正常修炼，想突破炼神境至少得半年时间。
大日阳神诀不愧是上品仙法，和武道功法简直是天壤之別。
还打算继续修炼，但楚夏的肚子却咕咕叫唤起来。
仔细一想，他从被困祖龙禁地到现在，已经过去了七八天时间，期间滴米未进，能撑到现在全凭意志力。
“你饿了嘛，要不要我叫人准备一些御膳来。”
睡在一旁的长公主早已甦醒过来，正好奇地打量著楚夏。
她的气色比之前明显好了很多。
她甦醒的时候，楚夏是知道的，只是当时他正在突破的关键阶段，见她很识趣的没有大喊大叫，所以就没管她。

但楚夏还是不放心：“用不著，你不用耍什么招，我很快就会离开这里。”
“怎么会呢，你救了我的命，我感激你还来不及。”
长公主露出一脸善意的微笑。
楚夏瞥了一眼她的小腹，黑气被吸走后，她的伤势似乎已经恢復大半。
“那也不用。”
楚夏端起放在床边的参汤，正准备喝下。
“如果我是你，我肯定不会喝的。”长公主忽然说道。
楚夏眉头一皱，似乎察觉到了什么，將手指探入参汤中。
顿时间，万神鼎又起了反应，竟从参汤之中吸走了一团毒素。
这毒……
楚夏太熟悉了。
正是夏蓝曦给他下的化气散。
content_en:
The Daqian Kingdom advocates martial arts, and warriors are divided into five realms: gathering energy, refining gods, communicating with the mysteries, resolving calamities, and being a master.
Becoming a grandmaster is equivalent to having a stepping stone to cultivating immortality.
However, the methods of cultivating immortals are all monopolized by the Daqian royal family. The royal family uses this as a bait to nearly control the entire martial arts power of the Daqian dynasty.
Chu Xia knew very well how difficult it was to obtain an immortal cultivation technique in Daqian.
My father served in the army for half his life and killed countless enemies. All he wanted was a technique for cultivating immortals, but he could not get what he wanted until his death.
Unexpectedly, Chu Xia obtained it so easily.
And it’s still a top-grade immortal technique!
Without any time to think about it, Chu Xia was already sitting cross-legged and began to use her spiritual power to practice the Great Sun Art.
This practice lasts for half a day.
When the sky gradually darkened, Chu Xia suddenly opened her eyes.
"I actually broke through to the realm of refining gods!"
Chu Xia was very pleasantly surprised.
Although he is at the ninth level of Qi Gathering, with normal cultivation, it will take at least half a year to break through to the God Refining Realm.
The Great Riyang Shen Jue is indeed a top-grade immortal technique, which is completely different from martial arts techniques.
She planned to continue practicing, but Chu Xia's stomach growled.
Thinking about it carefully, seven or eight days have passed since he was trapped in the Forbidden Land of the Ancestral Dragon. During this period, he has not eaten a single grain. His ability to survive until now depends entirely on his willpower.
"Are you hungry? Do you want me to ask someone to prepare some royal meals?"
The eldest princess who was sleeping next to her had already woken up and was looking at Chu Xia curiously.
Her complexion was obviously much better than before.
Chu Xia knew when she woke up, but he was at the critical stage of breakthrough at that time. Seeing that she was sensible enough not to yell, he ignored her.
But Chu Xia was still worried: "No need, you don't have to play any tricks, I will leave here soon."
"How could it be? You saved my life. I'm grateful to you before it was too late."
The eldest princess showed a kind smile.
Chu Xia glanced at her lower abdomen. After the black energy was sucked away, most of her injuries seemed to have recovered.
"That's not necessary."
Chu Xia picked up the ginseng soup placed beside the bed and was about to drink it.
"If I were you, I would definitely not drink it." The eldest princess suddenly said.
Chu Xia frowned, seeming to notice something, and dipped her fingers into the ginseng soup.
After a while, the Ten Thousand God Cauldron reacted again and actually sucked a bunch of toxins from the ginseng soup.
This poison...
Chu Xia is too familiar.
It was the Qi Transformation Powder that Xia Lanxi gave him.
